projects.title: JCK Crypto Exchange
projects.shortDescription: Complete visual identity and social media design system for crypto trading.
projects.description: A complete visual identity and social media system for a crypto trading platform that needed to feel secure, fast and unmistakably modern.
projects.objective: Build trust in a crowded market. The brand had to read as institutional-grade while staying approachable for first-time traders.
projects.process: Started with market and competitor mapping, then built a geometric mark from the exchange's candlestick motif. The identity was extended into a gradient-led social system with reusable templates for market updates, launches and announcements.
projects.challenge: Standing out in a competitive crypto landscape while conveying rock-solid security and intuitive usability.
projects.creativeDirection: Dark glassmorphic layers, neon cyan and violet gradients, and sharp geometric typography.
projects.results: 40% increase in social media engagement and a cohesive brand launch across 5 channels.

projects.title: Urban Streetwear Vector Graphic
projects.shortDescription: High-detail vector artwork for streetwear apparel drop with distressed cybernetic typography.
projects.description: Bespoke high-detail vector artwork for an autumn streetwear apparel drop featuring distressed typography and cybernetic aesthetic elements.
projects.objective: Create an iconic hero graphic that prints razor-sharp with screen-printing and high-density puff print techniques.
projects.process: Vector illustration drafting in Illustrator, texture blending in Photoshop, and color-separation setup for multi-screen apparel manufacturing.
projects.challenge: Translating fine line weights and halftone dot densities without losing fidelity during screen mesh exposure.
projects.creativeDirection: Cyberpunk aesthetics, dystopian Kanji lettering, and distressed halftone stippling.
projects.results: Over 2,500 units sold in the opening week with zero printing defect returns.

projects.title: Nifty Academy Platform
projects.shortDescription: Digital design language and course branding for an online learning platform.
projects.description: Digital design language and course branding for an online learning platform, covering the marketing site, lesson interface and content templates.
projects.objective: Make long study sessions comfortable and make every course feel like part of one family without flattening their individual personalities.
projects.process: Defined a dark-first interface palette with per-course accent colours, built a type scale tuned for dense reading, then produced a component kit that the team can extend for new courses.
projects.challenge: Organizing complex course materials into a distraction-free and motivating learning environment.
projects.creativeDirection: Clean editorial typography, focused dark surface contrasts, and modular card systems.
projects.results: Over 1,200 active students enrolled with overwhelmingly positive feedback on course clarity.

projects.title: High-CTR YouTube Thumbnails
projects.shortDescription: High-contrast thumbnails engineered for maximum click-through rates at mobile scale.
projects.description: A running series of high-contrast thumbnails designed around one rule: readable at 200 pixels wide.
projects.objective: Lift click-through rate without resorting to clickbait. Each thumbnail had to communicate the video's promise in under a second.
projects.process: Built a repeatable formula — isolated subject, controlled colour temperature, three-word maximum type block — then tested variants against channel analytics and refined the winners.
projects.challenge: Compressing storytelling into a tiny canvas that beats dense algorithmic feeds.
projects.creativeDirection: Dynamic facial emotion cutouts, 3D rim lighting, and punchy high-contrast typography.
projects.results: Average CTR increase of +3.8% across 12 client YouTube channels.

projects.title: Daily Social Content System
projects.shortDescription: High-engagement post, story, and carousel systems for daily publishing brands.
projects.description: Post, story and carousel systems designed for brands that publish daily and need speed without losing craft.
projects.objective: Make consistent output possible for small teams — templates that are hard to break and quick to fill.
projects.process: Audited each brand’s feed, defined a modular grid and a fixed set of layout archetypes, then delivered editable Figma and Canva kits with usage notes.
projects.challenge: Maintaining brand distinction across fast-paced daily publishing cycles.
projects.creativeDirection: Consistent 4:5 and 9:16 layout grids, striking focal points, and branded data visualization callouts.
projects.results: Over 200 bespoke social assets published across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

projects.title: Cyberpunk Apparel Graphic
projects.shortDescription: Futuristic oversized graphic tee artwork with Japanese typography and halftone gradients.
projects.description: Futuristic oversized graphic tee artwork incorporating Japanese kanji typography, glitch art and high-contrast halftone dots.
projects.objective: Deliver an eye-catching statement back-print graphic that resonates with the gaming and streetwear community.
projects.process: Concept moodboarding, custom hand-drawn typography, chromatic aberration distortion and digital vector finishing.
projects.challenge: Ensuring high-density vector line art reproduces with maximum impact on dark textile fabrics.
projects.creativeDirection: Glitch art textures, neon magenta-cyan accents, and bold typography scales.
projects.results: Selected as flagship winter drop headliner with sold-out stock.

projects.title: Monochrome Brand Identity
projects.shortDescription: Monochrome identity system with a single electric accent across stationery and packaging.
projects.description: A monochrome identity system with a single electric accent, applied across stationery, signage and packaging.
projects.objective: Give a young studio a mark with enough restraint to age well and enough character to stand out on a shelf.
projects.process: Sketching, logo grid construction, then a full guideline document covering spacing, misuse, colour behaviour on dark and light surfaces, and print specification.
projects.challenge: Balancing minimalist restraint with distinctive brand personality that prints crisply across physical textures.
projects.creativeDirection: High-contrast monochrome foundations accented by electric violet highlights.
projects.results: Unified brand asset library delivered with comprehensive print-ready vector packages.

projects.title: Fintech Instagram Carousels
projects.shortDescription: Educational carousel layouts explaining market concepts with visual storytelling.
projects.description: 10-slide educational carousel layouts explaining market concepts with visual storytelling and crisp data graphics.
projects.objective: Maximize carousel swipe-through rate and bookmark/save engagement metrics on Instagram and LinkedIn.
projects.process: Slide-by-slide hook design, seamless swipe transitions across split graphics, and bold typographic hierarchy.
projects.challenge: Simplifying complex technical indicators into visual diagrams that captivate mobile viewers.
projects.creativeDirection: Clean card elevations, luminous green trend accents, and fluid swipe lines.
projects.results: Achieved 3.2x average bookmark rate compared to previous text-heavy posts.

projects.title: Gaming & Tech Thumbnails
projects.shortDescription: High-impact 3D lighting composite thumbnails tailored for tech reviews and game walkthroughs.
projects.description: High-impact 3D lighting composite thumbnails tailored for tech reviews and game walkthrough episodes.
projects.objective: Outperform competitor thumbnails in algorithmic suggested feeds with sharp focus cues and readable typography.
projects.process: Subject multi-layer color grading, custom 3D typography extrusion, glow pass composites, and split-screen contrast testing.
projects.challenge: Generating distinct visual tension without crossing into clutter or deceptive clickbait.
projects.creativeDirection: High-saturation focal lighting, neon halos, and dynamic facial expression cutouts.
projects.results: Drove 450,000+ views in 14 days with strong viewer retention signals.

projects.title: Vintage Moto Club T-Shirt
projects.shortDescription: Handcrafted vintage typography and engine badge illustration for heavy-weight tees.
projects.description: Handcrafted vintage typography and engine badge illustration designed for premium cotton heavy-weight tees.
projects.objective: Capture an authentic 70s heritage garage vibe with hand-inked textures and badge geometries.
projects.process: Pencil sketches converted to clean bezier vector paths with distressed grunge overlays for authentic vintage printing.
projects.challenge: Crafting intricate linework that survives standard plastisol silk-screen printing washes.
projects.creativeDirection: Hand-lettered serifs, retro piston badges, and distressed parchment distressing.
projects.results: Official club merchandise line established across 4 colorways.

projects.title: Apex Trade Interface UI
projects.shortDescription: Modular, high-density dark mode trading terminal dashboard with responsive chart widgets.
projects.description: A modular, high-density dark mode trading terminal dashboard with responsive chart widgets and live order books.
projects.objective: Optimize data density without visual fatigue during prolonged multi-monitor market analysis sessions.
projects.process: User flow wireframing, dark palette contrast validation, component design system creation, and interactive Figma prototyping.
projects.challenge: Balancing complex real-time data widgets with uncluttered visual navigation.
projects.creativeDirection: Deep charcoal slate foundation with electric emerald and ruby order book indicators.
projects.results: Reduced user order placement friction time by 35% in usability testing.

projects.title: Luxury Foil Stationery Suite
projects.shortDescription: Gold foil stamped business cards, embossed letterheads, and tactile presentation folders.
projects.description: Gold foil stamped business cards, embossed letterheads, and tactile presentation folders for a luxury property group.
projects.objective: Communicate timeless prestige and meticulous attention to detail through premium physical print finishes.
projects.process: Die-line drafting, spot-UV and foil layer masking, pantone metallic ink calibration, and physical paper stock selection.
projects.challenge: Aligning precise foil stamping registration across heavy cotton card stocks.
projects.creativeDirection: Minimalist typography, deep forest green tactile cardstock, and warm gold foil.
projects.results: Delivered flagship presentation packages used across ultra-prime property sales.

projects.title: Neon Pulse Festival Poster
projects.shortDescription: Vibrant neon gradient typography and abstract 3D fluid art poster campaign.
projects.description: Vibrant neon gradient typography and abstract 3D fluid art poster campaign for an electronic music festival.
projects.objective: Generate massive organic social shares and street visibility through luminous typography and energetic visuals.
projects.process: 3D generative fluid simulation, layered typography composition, and large-format print proofing.
projects.challenge: Maintaining neon color brilliance across CMYK printing separation profiles.
projects.creativeDirection: Fluorescent CMYK spot channels, fluid metallic chrome typography, and kinetic energy.
projects.results: Featured across city transit centers with 10,000+ tickets sold out.

projects.title: Creator Brand Social Kit
projects.shortDescription: Multi-platform social branding suite covering YouTube banners, Twitter headers, and story packs.
projects.description: A multi-platform social branding suite covering YouTube banners, Twitter headers, TikTok avatars, and story packs.
projects.objective: Establish an immediately recognizable personal brand identity across all major content channels.
projects.process: Channel audit, unified color tokens, responsive banner safe-zone mapping for desktop and mobile devices.
projects.challenge: Ensuring critical avatar and banner elements remain visible across varying device crop ratios.
projects.creativeDirection: Sleek dark gradient glass with vibrant brand badges and modern typography.
projects.results: Unified digital presence rolled out across 4 social media platforms.

projects.title: Podcast Masterclass Covers
projects.shortDescription: Cinematic portrait composite thumbnails with custom lighting effects and clean episodic badges.
projects.description: Cinematic portrait composite thumbnails with custom lighting effects and clean episodic badge numbering.
projects.objective: Drive consistent CTR above 8% across episode releases with high-contrast guest focal treatments.
projects.process: Studio raw photo retouching, background frequency separation, custom title typography, and mobile feed testing.
projects.challenge: Balancing guest portrait prominence with fast-reading 3-word title hooks.
projects.creativeDirection: Cinematic warm-cool split lighting, subtle grain, and high-impact title typography.
projects.results: Episode CTR increased from 4.1% to 8.7% within the first 48 hours of each upload.

projects.title: Minimalist Monogram Tee
projects.shortDescription: Clean geometric emblem and pocket print typography created for streetwear merchandise lines.
projects.description: Clean geometric emblem and pocket print typography created for contemporary streetwear merchandise lines.
projects.objective: Create versatile apparel prints that look timeless across oversized tee and hoodie silhouettes.
projects.process: Minimalist logo geometry drafting, scale testing, mockup generation, and garment print specifications.

projects.results: Adopted as perpetual core staple in the client’s essential merchandise lineup.
